scripts.dev:backend: cd src/backend && cross-env DOCKORE_RELOAD=1 uv run python -m app.main
scripts.build:backend: cd src/backend && uv run --extra dev python scripts/build.py
scripts.build: pnpm gen:api && pnpm build:shared && pnpm build:backend && pnpm build:frontend
scripts.test:backend: cd src/backend && uv run --extra dev pytest
scripts.test: pnpm test:shared && pnpm test:backend && pnpm test:frontend
